summary: Full diagnostic of the Antigravity system's context window economics. Maps exactly where tokens are consumed across static system prompt components and dynamic session loading. Identifies the #1 bloat source (524 workflow listings consuming ~17K tokens before a word is typed) and provides a tiered optimization plan that preserves depth while cutting overhead by 40-60%. Includes concrete implementation steps: workflow index restructuring, genius file compression, tiered loading enforcement, and session hygiene protocols.
